---
description: Analyze iperf3 results
---
Following files are iperf3 test results produced with [iperf.ps1](../../iperf.ps1). What observations can be made? Hints and conventions to follow:
- iperf.ps1 produces not only the raw result `iperf/{file-name}.json` but also a condensed result `iperf/{file-name}` with [getts.ps1](../../getts.ps1). Augment your analysis by leveraging the condensed result so you don't redo corresponding statistics.
- Present analysis in MiB.
